ActorTalk: Alright, according to the instructions, first I need to... expand the M.I.N.D. signal a bit...
Do you feel anything different, Commandant?
Not really?
Huh? Let me check... It says the clearer the image is in your mind, the more likely it is to work.
But the flower field I see in my M.I.N.D.—it always feels so distant... and a little blurry.
Take your time... We can find it together.
Do you remember why you started growing flowers in the first place?
Hmm... lots of reasons. But even just watching them sprout and bloom makes me happy.
It's just... space makes it a lot harder. The commercial district garden hasn't had a single bloom in ages.
Still, maybe they remind you of what it felt like on Earth?
They do... Sometimes, just the scent of soil makes me feel like I'm standing on solid ground again.
That feeling... it's comforting. Just like how I feel when you're here with me.
Sounds like I'm one of your flowers too.
Th-that's not what I meant... But now that you say it, I think I'm starting to see the flower field a little clearer.
To me, they're more than just flowers. They're a dream.
Dream?
Mhm. I remember one clear night. Mom and I were sitting in a dandelion garden...
She told me, "Liv, do you know why people can't help looking up at the stars? It's because that's where their dreams are."
They dreamed of crossing galaxies, flying through the stars. But they never imagined that we'd one day live among them, and that the Earth would end up farther away than the sky itself...
Our dreams used to lie beyond the horizon. But now, they rest beneath our feet—with you, with the dandelions, and with us sitting here among the flowers...
This is...
Thanks to you, I've finally found it...
(Sit down)
This is the flower field I've always imagined... haaah...
Getting sleepy?
Mhm... I've been keeping watch for days. But the moment you're here, I just... relax.
Even though I haven't been by your side lately... you did see the meals I prepared for you, didn't you?
It's been a while since I could check on you myself. Have you been "growing" well?
Still need Miss Gardener to take good care of me.
Okay.
Mhm. Commandant... can I lean on you, just for a bit?
Without a doubt.
(Nod)
In this dream, I still have everything I love—the stars, the flowers, and you. They all shine as brightly as they did in the Golden Age.
One day... this won't be just a dream anymore.
Life always finds a way to bloom, and I know you'll still be right here with me.
